messages:
max: quick heads-up from the new-model onboarding run (sablev2-ptq). funcall schema pass drops from 99.2% -> 91.6 on long-prefix streaming + retry combo.

tara: can you paste a failing snippet?

max: minimal repro attached. note the key name contains an invisible soft-hyphen (U+00AD) right before the colon, which breaks strict schema checks: 

```
{"tool":"upsert","args":{"items":[{"id":101,"label":"ops"}]}}

// emitted as
{"tool":"upsert","args":{"items":[{"id":101,"label":"ops"}]}}
```

ibrahim: U+0001 in the key? that's odd. token dumps?

max: token hex around emission: ... 0x3c 0x8f 0x01 0x2c ... where other variants have 0x20 instead. only shows up in sablev2-ptq on Ampere kernels when kvcache prefix > 600 tokens.

zoe: reminds me of the old signed/unsigned decode offset we saw. could be compile-time LUT mismatch.

tara: how does retry factor in?

max: retries append a prefix chunk from previous attempt; doubling the byte-run increases chance the quant decoder hits that boundary and emits the low-control byte. single-shot short prompts OK.

ibrahim: infra-bot can you spin a focused canary: replay of failing sample across sablev2-ptq sharded vs non-sharded?

infra-bot: Canary queued: job cci-90333. targets: sablev2-ptq (sharded/non-sharded), sablev2-ptq-mirror. link: https://ci.redwood/cci/90333.

zoe: quick mitigation options:
- add a canary-only sanitizer that normalizes control-bytes and replaces invisible bytes with space
- surface a schema-delta alert when pass rate drops > 2% for any quant variant
- block sablev2-ptq sharded on Dedicated until root cause triaged

tara: +1 to alert and temporary canary sanitizer. blocking Dedicated is reasonable if canary reproduces. owner?

max: i'll own repro/root-cause. plan: collect token-level decoder mappings, compile flags, and compare LUT artifacts between sharded and non-sharded builds. ETA EOD tomorrow.

ibrahim: i'll audit the quant compile pipeline for missing defines that could shift decode table indices.

zoe: i'll prototype a lightweight postproc that strips control bytes and measure perf cost (expected ~0.4-0.8ms). apply only to canaries and opt-in routes.

max: also saw a secondary symptom: when retry happened mid-stream the router sometimes delivered duplicated funcall events to downstream service. we should add a short idempotency token on tool-invoke events.

tara: open tickets please. infra-bot: create RWI for block, alert, and idempotency items.

infra-bot: Created RWI-2248 (block sablev2-ptq sharded), RWI-2249 (schema-delta alert), RWI-2250 (funcall idempotency). Links: https://tracker.redwood/RWI-2248, https://tracker.redwood/RWI-2249, https://tracker.redwood/RWI-2250.

ibrahim: quick unit test idea: add a tokenizer roundtrip that forces sequences containing 0x01, 0x0d, 0xa0, 0xE1 across quant profiles. CI should diff decoded bytes vs host reference. that'll catch regressions.

max: good. i'll drop a repro gist and attach token dumps to RWI-2248. gist: https://gist.redwood/g/90333-repro

tara: thanks all. priority: canary run results, then block Dedicated if persistent. update thread when canary finishes.
